notes.title: New Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Based on community feedback, a new update for Silent Signals is here! Here’s what’s improved in this version:

✅ Achievements added! Now you can unlock achievements as you progress.
✅ Grammar fixes! Texts have been revised for a smoother and error-free experience.
✅ Sound settings added! Separate sliders for music and sound effects let you adjust audio as you like.
✅ Bug fixes! Various gameplay-affecting bugs have been resolved.

Your feedback helps us make Silent Signals even better. Try out the update and let us know what you think! 🎮💡
